offers_products.reason: Sells cloud fax (eFax), interoperability and AI data-extraction software platforms delivered as SaaS.

offers_services.reason: Managed services team exists for deployments, but it supports the software; the main offering is the platform.

sells_to_consumers.reason: eFax personal plans sell to individuals, though the business is mostly organizational.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Healthcare providers, finance, Fortune 500 firms and federal agencies (ECFax) buy its cloud fax and interoperability tools.

recurring_revenue.reason: Subscription plans for eFax with monthly page allowances and enterprise subscriptions.

cyclical_demand.reason: Healthcare and regulated-industry fax and document exchange is a mission-critical, compliance-driven subscription.

big_ticket.reason: Small monthly subscriptions and usage-based plans, bought frequently.

people_delivered.reason: Value is in cloud software, network and technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers range from individuals and small practices to enterprises and federal agencies; the mix is broad and mixed.

asset_heavy.reason: Cloud software hosted on AWS; growth needs little physical plant or fleet investment.

notes: Customer mix is broad (small users to enterprise and federal), so the large-customer answer is uncertain.
